statement: node-0's continuous event-loop starvation in the MovieLens live lane is relieved at its profiled source: the control-plane publication-recovery/priority-recovery readiness snapshot construction path (the normalization cluster around normalizeDistinctStringArray/normalizePriorityRecoveryStringList/buildPublicationRecoveryGateSnapshot, its synchronous better-sqlite3 statement executions, and the allocation pressure they generate - measured as the dominant frames across 12 profiled gap windows on run 2026-08-04T11-25-03) no longer starves the seed's event loop: the live lane's host-scheduling budget holds on node-0 (blocked <=20% of log span, no single gap >10s, total gaps <=60s) with readiness/publication-recovery semantics unchanged (same decisions from the same evidence), via measured-cadence reduction, per-version snapshot reuse, or batching that yields the loop - the lever chosen from measurement, not guess.

constraints.statement: If this Quest changes source code, spawn a subagent verifier before audit and git handoff, then record a Solver finding with evidence subagent:<id>.

Readiness, publication-recovery, and priority-recovery DECISIONS must be unchanged: the same evidence yields the same gate states, blockers, and reason codes. Only when/how often the snapshots are constructed, how their inputs are read, and how intermediate values are allocated/reused may change. No budget, threshold, or workload change in the live lane.

Before implementing a lever, establish the rebuild cadence and per-call cost of the targeted snapshot path with deterministic evidence (test or instrumented run) so the lever targets the measured dominant term (cadence x per-call cost x allocation), not a guessed one. Inherited rulesOut stand: reconcile/heal sweeps are non-dominant and are not this quest's target.

Before any live run, prove the lever deterministically: a test that pins the changed construction path (cache hit/reuse or deferred batch) produces byte-identical snapshot decisions versus the unchanged path on the same evidence, and red-on-revert for the mechanism. Live runs are serial and respect the thermal policy (hold if CPU package >=75C or NVMe Sensor 2 >=78C).
